method: Closing Brompton Electric's CATALOG-DEPTH.md gap (Short: 2 of its 4 in GB to go) against the whole range counted in docs/research/catalog-ranges.json. SLATE already held the Electric C Line and Electric P Line (as '... e-Motiq (4-speed)' trims); the Electric T Line's GB price was read live on brompton.com (the 1-speed e-Motiq model's own product page, which the depth-fill-2 moto research also used as its UK list-price basis); the Electric G Line's GB price was read secondhand, via search, off brompton.com's own 4-speed Roller Frame product page, since the page did not render in a direct fetch.
